raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 was re-delivered at 05:00 on 2026-01-17, appending about 317 second copies of transactions already loaded at 02:00 (668 rows against a normal ~350). txn_id is a dense unique range, so these are retransmissions, and silver_transactions never deduplicates on txn_id, which inflates 2026-01-16 and every gold table. Copies are confirmed identical only in one sample, so the dedupe keeps the latest ingest_ts per txn_id and then applies the POSTED filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(d.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, d.customer_id, CAST(d.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(d.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(d.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(d.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT r.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.txn_id ORDER BY r.ingest_ts DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions r) d WHERE d.rn = 1 AND d.status = 'POSTED';"}}
